description: A-30 detector. Every 5 minutes, finds check-ins that are past due and were never sent (sent_at IS NULL, not cancelled, 15 min to 2 h overdue) and alerts Talal via Telegram and Gmail. Silent when nothing is overdue.
name: ElderWise WF-7 - Dispatch Watchdog

parameters.query:
SELECT count(*)::int AS overdue_count,
       to_char(min(c.scheduled_for) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS oldest_due_riyadh,
       string_agg(DISTINCT c.domain::text, ', ') AS domains,
       string_agg(DISTINCT e.first_name, ', ') AS elders
FROM checkins c
JOIN elders e ON e.id = c.elder_id
WHERE c.sent_at IS NULL
  AND c.cancelled_at IS NULL
  AND e.active
  AND e.consent_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
  AND c.scheduled_for < now() - interval '15 minutes'
  AND c.scheduled_for > now() - interval '2 hours'
HAVING count(*) > 0

parameters.subject: ElderWise P1 - check-ins past due and never sent
